title: Pin the host-native MakeRelative separator on Windows
outcome: A product-parser regression compares the raw non-identical MakeRelative scalar against a host-native relative path before path normalization.
acceptance: A Windows-capable test uses different project and imported-file directories and asserts a raw conditional or assembly-name value containing the native separator and trailing separator.
The test fails if MakeRelativeDirectory emits '/' instead of Path.DirectorySeparatorChar on Windows.
